title: Diwali Skincare Routine: A Countdown Plan to 8 November
ex: A day-by-day Diwali skincare routine for the last week to 8 November, a festival-day plan around puja and make-up, and how to care for skin after crackers, smoke and Chhath.
rt: Diwali Skincare Routine 2026: Countdown Plan | Mirc Glow
rd: Diwali skincare routine for 2026: a countdown to 8 November, festival-day steps, and gentle care for skin after crackers, smoke and late nights.
quick: With a week to go, keep a simple routine: gentle cleanser, moisturiser, morning sunscreen and night cream, and no new products. Book a facial only if it is at least 5–6 days before Diwali. Afterwards, double cleanse, moisturise and pause scrubs for a few days.
facts: One week gives hydration and a rested look; tone needs 8–12 weeks
No new products in the last week; facials at least 5–6 days before
Double cleanse after crackers and make-up
